sampling: Uniform unordered distinct-name pair within each crystal-system stratum, then fair random fixed orientation. Identical CGD space-group setting strings, d=3. Exclude both orientations of all previous cohorts and all catalogue listed duals. No size, degree, rank, rigidity, contact symmetry, mechanism, or flatness filtering.
placement: As in the first test: origin on the 8^3 clearance grid, contacts within 1.05 of the nearest, exact common primitive cell.
spectra: As in the first test: 32 random wavevectors (seed 20261122), relative tolerance 1e-8.
excluded_note: Both orientations of every pair of the retrospective rows, the first prospective test (final and initial draw) and 12 different-group dual pairs.
